snippet.title: Teaser Vagalume
snippet.description:
Vagalume is light and darkness. Join Alcira as she searches for a stolen child through a land ravaged by war and the presence of vicious mythological creatures with the only help of a mysterious lantern…

Find out more at: https://vagalumegame.com/home
